text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock D and Stock B after large gains; a profit alone is not a reason to sell, so I should consider each holding’s prospects and role in my portfolio.","I tend to judge stocks separately against my purchase price. I should assess my whole portfolio and its risks instead of letting each position’s gain or loss drive my decisions.","I rarely trade, which can help me avoid reacting to short-term swings, but I should still review my holdings periodically and rebalance when my plan calls for it."]}
